Flash-drive printing

Copy the .ZPL filePlace it at the top level of the shared USB flash drive, not inside a folder.
Insert the driveUse a front USB host port on the ZT620.
Open the printer storage menuOn the printer touchscreen, hit "Menu" at bottom, then the Folder icon at top right.
Print from USBChoose Print: From USB and then choose your file. Hit the check mark to print.
Verify the first labelCheck alignment and scan every barcode type used on the label.

USB warning: Do not use a flash drive larger than 16 GB. The drive must be FAT/FAT32, the .ZPL file must be in the root, and Windows must not have added a hidden .TXT extension.
